status: Synthetic development diagnostic, not a benchmark or novel-method evaluation
records: first training trajectory of each material
query_selection: 16 initially visible particle centers, deterministic farthest-point sampling in first frame only
render: opaque gray radius-2 splats; fixed orthographic camera; no unique particle texture or source-label coloring in inputs
models: RAFT large C_T_SKHT_V2 with bilinear flow integration
metrics: Mean pixel tracking error over ground-truth-visible queries, excluding initial frame; GT visibility from rendered center ID buffer. Not TAP-Vid AJ.
limitations: Sparse sampling with potentially severe motion aliasing
Particle-splat domain differs from natural videos
CoTracker3 uses full future clip; RAFT integrates causal pairwise flow
Models track points, not full material-origin fields
No proposed Matter Memory model evaluated
